boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 79 is a two-phase board. First you drain a huge purple `17` reservoir sitting under two cramped upper wells. Then the board collapses into a lower tray where a purple bridge-shaped piece must move before the blue and orange blocks on the right can escape.
landmarks: Block Out Level 79 is a two-phase board.
First you drain a huge purple `17` reservoir sitting under two cramped upper wells.
Then the board collapses into a lower tray where a purple bridge-shaped piece must move before the blue and orange blocks on the right can escape.

quickTips: Treat the big `17` reservoir as the opener, not the `7` chamber.
When the lower tray appears, open the left side before you try to free the blue steps on the right.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Drain the giant bottom chamber marked `17` before you overwork either top well.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: While that reservoir is falling, clean the upper-left lane by moving the red L-shape and green stair out of each other's way.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Start reducing the upper-right `7` chamber only after the left well is no longer clogging the side counters.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: When both purple chambers are gone, switch focus to the lower tray that appears beneath them.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Open the left side of that lower tray first, then move the purple bridge piece so the blue stepped block on the right has a route.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the right-side blue and orange blocks after the center lane is empty.

failurePoints: Treating the upper-right `7` chamber as the first target instead of draining the `17` reservoir underneath it.
Trying to clear the right-side blue steps in the lower tray before the purple bridge piece has moved.
